searchText: maybe we can bring this up on acd call, but ideally probably a better topic for peerdas call next tuesday. Let’s wait until Tuesday. Based on the reactions here, it seems too soon to move PeerDAS to Fulu. We can sit on that PR until we’re ready. if not yet a _real fork schedule_, can we just replace the `EIP7594` phrasing, from upcoming releases, or from Kurtosis configs? Because real or not, too soon or not, we are treating it as an actual fork, post electra. cc <@412614104222531604> was that actually agreed on? > from Kurtosis configs preferably kt configs atleast no reason not to leave it as `eip7594_fork_epoch` and then treat it as that fork and we already can configure when we want to have eip7594_fork_epoch to be set and it also has a `eip7594_fork_version` field in kt so you can basically already test post pectra forks too cool You would just do something like: ```yaml network_params: electra_fork_epoch: 1 eip7594_fork_epoch: 2 eip7594_fork_version: <whateveryouwant> ``` i'm asking to drop the eip7594 name with fulu, in the config fulu gonna trigger eof question is, if we wanna complicate peerdas with eof + electra as well I know eof shouldn't affect anything for peerdas can we not do just `peerdas-as-fulu` for _just_ the devnets but currently I just don't see that massive progression on peerdas's side where we could 99% say that peerdas will be ready to ship by fulu check dm adding a fork is quite the change for us, and if we add a temporary fork, it stalls us from merging, or even testing it on our own runners. which is why we really want to stick with this setup cc <@531934490826768418> <@792822129019584562> <@425907307621122049> <@466006586477772831> <@498331483732312075> I'm currently making it soft fork in electra. If it will have fork version different to electra, it's another big work for me I'm ok to trigger it with fulu epoch if fork version == electra otherwise we need extra time in Teku for this update Overall I think it makes sense as it will be definitely not a part of Electra. But I want to keep eip7594 fork epoch line to test soft forking. It could be == fulu epoch in all devnets, but it would be good to test new logic in Teku (and maybe other clients want it too) nimbus doesn't really have a structure to handle soft forks, so either everything in peerdas is named as EIP7594..., then we can parse that and assume it as FULU (because fundamentally our FULU fork schedule doesn't do anything else), or if it is actually named FULU, both epoch and version We didn't have it too, so we've added new functionality when moving PeerDAS to Electra (still in progress) and I'm curious to test it, it's interesting. PeerDAS supports soft-forking and it would be good to try it out and find how it could work.
